VERDICT
Proceed with two-tier system: per-repo `MAP.md` (single loadable file, ≤600 tokens) + central `INDEX.md` (~150 tokens/repo). Imitate Stacker via fixed section order so agents learn the parse pattern. Build manually first; script only the directory-tree section. Ship one repo (most cross-connected, likely llm-bridge) as pilot before rolling out to all five.

REASONING
- Single file per repo satisfies the load-one-file constraint; a central index handles cross-repo routing so agents never open the wrong repo.
- Hard token budget forces signal density; maps that bloat get skipped by agents, defeating the purpose.
- Fixed section order = predictable parsing; agents cheaply jump to "Start here" or "Gotchas" without scanning.
- "Do-not-read" list saves more tokens than any positive description; explicit exclusions (data/, generated/, dist/) stop exploratory reads.
- Staleness is the main failure mode. Mitigate with `last_verified` date + regeneration only on structural triggers (new top-level dir, new entry point, changed run command) — not per commit. Per-commit maintenance will be abandoned within weeks.
- Naming: many agents auto-ingest `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md`. Keep `MAP.md` as source of truth; make AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md a 3-line pointer to it. Avoids duplication drift.
- Manual authorship beats auto-generation for the high-signal parts (purpose, gotchas, current state); auto-generate only the tree, which is mechanical.
- "Current state" section is the highest-value, cheapest-to-maintain field: 2-3 lines updated at end of each work session by the agent itself, as a standing rule.

NEXT_STEPS
1. Create `MAP.template.md` with this fixed section order: (1) Purpose+Status+last_verified (2) Start here: exact setup/run/test commands (3) Directory map: `tree -L 2 -I 'node_modules|dist|.git|__pycache__'`, one-line annotation per dir (4) Key files: entry points + core modules w/ symbols (5) Architecture: 3-5 bullet data flow (6) Relationships: repos it talks to + interface (port/API/file) (7) Gotchas: known traps (8) Current state: in-progress, broken, where work lives (9) Conventions: style/test/commit (10) Do-not-read: excluded paths.
2. Create central `~/INDEX.md` (or in a dotfiles/notes repo): table of all 5 repos — path, one-line purpose, status, depends-on/used-by.
3. Write pilot `MAP.md` for llm-bridge (most relationships; validates section 6 hardest).
4. Add
